label: preparing
what: A great-hall gathering / evening hospitality event, with 200 loaves of bread as refreshments and eight lanterns installed. The innkeeper, builder, and freight operator coordinated the hospitality; the baker delivered the loaves. Record does not establish whether the mayor had been informed beforehand; the evidence shows he was told by day 1, 09:12, and the secretary later notes an existing evening appointment. Therefore the 'not told about' condition is not clearly supported.
